api_key.description: API key for Sonarr authentication. Can be specified via the `SONARR_API_KEY` environment variable.

extra_headers.description: Extra headers to be sent along with all Sonarr requests. If this attribute is unset, it can be specified via environment variables following this pattern `SONARR_EXTRA_HEADER_${Header-Name}=${Header-Value}`.

url.description: Full Sonarr URL with protocol and port (e.g. `https://test.sonarr.tv:8989`). You should **NOT** supply any path (`/api`), the SDK will use the appropriate paths. Can be specified via the `SONARR_URL` environment variable.

block.description:
